xiaohongshu-hot-daily v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Automatically fetches Top 30 trending Xiaohongshu posts daily.
- Generates AI-powered summaries with smart category detection (e.g., beauty, travel, food).
- Supports multi-channel push notifications (Telegram, WeChat, email).
- Provides daily scheduling for automatic updates.
- Includes post stats: likes, favorites, comments.
- Free and Pro versions available; Pro unlocks more features and extended limits.
